Coppergate student accommodation consists of a 6-storey- and 14-storey building, providing accommodation for up to 310 students in Studio and En-suite rooms. Each bedroom has a warm double bed, full-length mirror, spacious wardrobe and study area. Meanwhile, the kitchens are fully equipped with dishwashers, ovens, hob racks, microwaves and freestanding fridges. It is worth mentioning that each Studio room inside Coppergate has its own washing machine, which students can use for free. In addition, the flats have a communal gym, games area, cinema viewing area and study rooms for students to use. With all-inclusive rent, students don't have to worry about paying fees.

There are several bus stops within 4 minute's walk, making it easy for students to commute to classes. Swansea train station is a 13-minute walk away and provides easy access to other cities in the UK.
